title: Virtual Compute: primary usage unit
content:
## Meaning — primary usage unit

Virtual Compute primary usage unit: Primary meter quantity unit; string.

## Tier values — primary usage unit

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — primary usage unit: instance-hour.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — primary usage unit: instance-hour.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — primary usage unit: instance-hour.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — primary usage unit: instance-hour.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — primary usage unit: instance-hour.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — primary usage unit: instance-hour.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for primary usage unit?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has primary usage unit of instance-hour.

## Meaning — included primary quantity

Virtual Compute included primary quantity: Primary meter quantity included per holding per complete month, prorated by active seconds; decimal.
